mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_cancellations (event_id, reason, cancelled_by, cancelled_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{reason}, #{cancelledBy}, #{cancelledAt}) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT hold_id, user_id FROM reservations WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND reservation_id IN (SELECT id FROM reservations WHERE event_id = #{eventId})
mapper.select: SELECT o.id FROM orders o JOIN reservations r ON r.id = o.reservation_id WHERE r.event_id = #{eventId} AND o.status = 'PAID' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets t WHERE t.order_id = o.id AND t.status = 'USED') ORDER BY o.created_at ASC, o.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'REFUNDED') AS refunded, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets t WHERE t.order_id = o.id AND t.status = 'USED') ) AS remaining, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets t WHERE t.order_id = o.id AND t.status = 'USED') ) AS needs_attention FROM orders o JOIN reservations r ON r.id = o.reservation_id WHERE r.event_id = #{eventId}
